record_type_quote: Thus, we conducted high-powered preregistered replications of the two subliminal anchoring studies.

targets.title: Subliminal anchoring: Judgmental consequences and underlying mechanisms
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a high-powered, preregistered, close replication of Study 2 in which participants estimated the average price of a middle-class car.
targets.outcome_quote: Instead of moving forward and building on existing bricks, we resolved a contradiction between two findings by showing that neither of them could be replicated. There is currently no convincing evidence of the existence of subliminal anchoring.
